body:
Unicode range is 21-bit, so original description is accurate: 21 - Unicode, 11 - flags (but not all bits are used):

```
0-20 // Unicode value (0x00 - 0x10FFFF range)
21   // Reserved
22   // Special key flag
23   // Reserved
24   // CTRL or CMD flag
25   // SHIFT flag
26   // ALT flag
27   // META flag
28   // CTRL flag
29   // KEYPAD flag
30   // GROUP SWITCH flag
31   // Reserved (propably should stay permanently unused and set to zero, to avoid any issues with signed/unsigned conversions).
```
